docs.summary: Steers root motion so a body part reaches a target by a point in the animation. Each update, ask for the correction for the ramp's advance and fold it into the root delta with [`CorrectRootDelta`](#api~Prowl.Motion.MatchTarget~CorrectRootDelta).

members.name: ComputeRampWeight
members.signature: public static float ComputeRampWeight(float currentNormalizedTime, float startTime, float targetTime)

members.name: ComputeCorrection
members.signature: public static Transform3D ComputeCorrection(Transform3D bodyPart, Transform3D matchTarget, Float3 positionWeight, float rotationWeight, float previousRampWeight, float currentRampWeight)

docs.summary: The correction for one update in which the ramp advanced from `previousRampWeight` to `currentRampWeight`: the share (current minus previous) over (1 minus previous) of the remaining error. See [`ComputeCorrection`](#api~Prowl.Motion.MatchTarget~ComputeCorrection).

members.name: ComputeCorrection
members.signature: public static Transform3D ComputeCorrection(Transform3D bodyPart, Transform3D matchTarget, Float3 positionWeight, float rotationWeight, float fraction)

docs.summary: A correction moving `bodyPart` the given `fraction` of the way to `matchTarget`, pivoting about the body part, in the target's space.

members.name: CorrectRootDelta
members.signature: public static Transform3D CorrectRootDelta(Transform3D characterTransform, Transform3D rootDelta, Transform3D correction)

docs.summary: Folds a correction into a root delta. `characterTransform` is the character in the correction's space before the delta is applied. The result, applied as character * delta, lands the character where correction * character * rootDelta would.
